source_documents.title: Excited state dynamics and exciton difusion in triphenylamine/dicyanovinyl push–pull small molecule for organic optoelectronics

reference_evidence_units.quote: lifetime values of ~ 0.04 ns in toluene and ~ 0.4 ns in chloroform
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-T-DCV-Ph-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Dilute toluene/chloroform, dispersed PMMA matrix and spin-coated neat films; time-resolved PL excited at 520 nm and source TDDFT.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Dilute-solution lifetimes are about 0.04 and 0.4 ns with PL yields 0.01 and 0.04, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Source monoexponential fits; Figure 2 visually inspected. Different solvents must not be pooled.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This resulted in much longer excited state lifetime of ~ 3 ns with the corresponding increase in PL QY
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-T-DCV-Ph-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Dilute toluene/chloroform, dispersed PMMA matrix and spin-coated neat films; time-resolved PL excited at 520 nm and source TDDFT.
reference_evidence_units.statement: PMMA dispersion gives about 3 ns lifetime; Figure 2b labels QY approximately 0.2.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Matrix is intended to constrain conformations while limiting intermolecular interactions, not to demonstrate dye aggregation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: TPA-T-DCV-Ph-F undergoes strong change in dipole moment upon photoexcitation
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-T-DCV-Ph-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Dilute toluene/chloroform, dispersed PMMA matrix and spin-coated neat films; time-resolved PL excited at 520 nm and source TDDFT.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source invokes CT-related dipole redistribution and solvent stabilization to explain solvent-dependent relaxation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Detailed orbital calculations are referenced to ESI section 3, not inspected here; no PET reaction or verified TICT state is claimed.

reference_evidence_units.quote: We therefore propose that this geometry is close to a CI.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-T-DCV-Ph-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Dilute toluene/chloroform, dispersed PMMA matrix and spin-coated neat films; time-resolved PL excited at 520 nm and source TDDFT.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Excited-state optimization approaches near-degenerate S0/S1 where TDDFT fails; the authors propose proximity to a CI.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: An approximate inference from convergence failure and interpolated surfaces, not a located exact multireference MECI.

reference_evidence_units.quote: where the relatively large molecular deformation needed to reach the CI is efficiently suppressed
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-T-DCV-Ph-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Dilute toluene/chloroform, dispersed PMMA matrix and spin-coated neat films; time-resolved PL excited at 520 nm and source TDDFT.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Rigid surroundings are proposed to suppress CI-reaching deformation and lengthen emission lifetime.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Conditional mechanistic interpretation supported by the matrix comparison, not direct time-resolved CI observation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: We did not explicitly calculate the rates for ISC and CI
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-T-DCV-Ph-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Dilute toluene/chloroform, dispersed PMMA matrix and spin-coated neat films; time-resolved PL excited at 520 nm and source TDDFT.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Singlet-triplet crossings are present in the illustrative surfaces, but the authors expect ISC to be slow relative to CI decay.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No calculated branching rates or observed triplet kinetics; do not assign a positive triplet mechanism from the diagram alone.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The weighted average exciton lifetime was determined to be ~ 3.7 ns while the measured PL QY was ~ 0.17.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-T-DCV-Ph-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Dilute toluene/chloroform, dispersed PMMA matrix and spin-coated neat films; time-resolved PL excited at 520 nm and source TDDFT.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Neat films have a biexponential transient and weighted lifetime about 3.7 ns with QY about 0.17.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The fast component is attributed to intermolecular energy transfer and excitonic traps; these are not the isolated PMMA conditions.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The exciton diffusion length of ~ 16 nm was derived from the exciton displacement statistics
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-T-DCV-Ph-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Dilute toluene/chloroform, dispersed PMMA matrix and spin-coated neat films; time-resolved PL excited at 520 nm and source TDDFT.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Source Monte Carlo fits to PC60BM volume-quenching data estimate about 16 nm diffusion length in solution-processed films.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Model-derived, with approximately 65 meV energetic disorder and fitted hopping time; no new inference simulation was performed.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The excitation power was set between 0.5–4 µW to avoid the possibility of exciton-exciton annihilation and photobleaching.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-T-DCV-Ph-F
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Dilute toluene/chloroform, dispersed PMMA matrix and spin-coated neat films; time-resolved PL excited at 520 nm and source TDDFT.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The time-resolved PL protocol limits excitation power to reduce annihilation and bleaching artifacts.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A design control, not proof that all such effects are absent; dilute-solution optical densities were 0.06-0.12.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Conformational restriction is explicitly tested by PMMA and used in the source interpretation; it overlaps with the proposed CI-access pathway.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Rigid PMMA and neat-film environments suppress large conformational relaxation; PMMA is not treated as an aggregate.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: CT-related excited-state dipole change and solvent stabilization are reported; no specific twisted geometry is established.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Film exciton migration and trap-related nonradiative relaxation contribute to the film photophysics, separately from the isolated-molecule matrix effect.

reference_mechanisms.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Preserve the authors' approximate CI explanation, explicitly bounded by TDDFT failure rather than exact CI optimization.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Conformational restriction is explicitly tested by PMMA and used in the source interpretation; it overlaps with the proposed CI-access pathway.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Rigid PMMA and neat-film environments suppress large conformational relaxation; PMMA is not treated as an aggregate.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest binding, pore uptake or host inclusion mechanism is established; a solvent or self-assembly is not automatically host-guest chemistry.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: CT-related excited-state dipole change and solvent stabilization are reported; no specific twisted geometry is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific excited-state proton-transfer pathway is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on is established; energy transfer and CT character are not by themselves PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Film exciton migration and trap-related nonradiative relaxation contribute to the film photophysics, separately from the isolated-molecule matrix effect.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Lifetime/yield differences support changed nonradiative behavior but no independent radiative-rate mechanism is isolated.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: ISC is considered but expected too slow to dominate, and no rates were calculated.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Preserve the authors' approximate CI explanation, explicitly bounded by TDDFT failure rather than exact CI optimization.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-singlet-state emission or anti-Kasha mechanism is established; higher-state absorption alone is insufficient.
